baseline.description: stock terminfo.dev@4.0.0 collector run, graded cases only

stock.note: The stock collector (scripts/terminfo-baseline.mjs) needs an interactive Ntilde tab and was not re-run for this batch. The pinned bundle (aa5f2bf9...), probeHash 16a690f34c0e and the App source are unchanged since the erase-in-line baseline (stock run 0eae87166a02ba222074d074f798b125: 168 inconclusive, 86 supported, 1 unsupported), so those counts are carried, not re-measured. No stock grade is changed by this batch.

The stock collector (scripts/terminfo-baseline.mjs) needs an interactive Ntilde tab and was not re-run for this batch. The stock per-case outcomes of the three pinned cases cannot depend on the implemented behavior: the pinned terminal paths of editing.deccara and editing.decrara end in a cursor-position query (unmeasuredCellResult, never a verdict) and editing.decsace is a not-attempted placeholder. The counts are carried, not re-measured: they are the stock baseline 2026-11-09-stock-baseline.json (stock run 02be5c606e0e7d79ab8e11f142d21ae0); no stock grade is changed by this batch.

Stock cursor.cup-scroll-region, cursor.hide and cursor.shape are inconclusive and stock cursor.reverse-wrap is an ungraded UndeclaredTerminalGeometry collector error (suiteComplete=false); all unchanged by this run. The stock hide and shape app callbacks end inconclusive because the owned stock run supplies no capture adapter.

The stock collector (scripts/terminfo-baseline.mjs) needs an interactive Ntilde tab and was not re-run for this batch. The pinned bundle (aa5f2bf9...), probeHash 16a690f34c0e and the App source are unchanged since the saved-state/reset baseline (stock run 02be5c606e0e7d79ab8e11f142d21ae0: 168 inconclusive, 86 supported, 1 unsupported), so those counts are carried, not re-measured. No stock grade is changed by this batch.

The stock collector (scripts/terminfo-baseline.mjs) needs an interactive Ntilde tab and was not re-run for this batch. The pinned bundle (aa5f2bf9...), probeHash 16a690f34c0e and the pinned probes are unchanged since the retained stock baseline (168 inconclusive, 86 supported, 1 unsupported), so those counts are carried, not re-measured. The owned run raw.json is the pinned bundle executed through the owned adapter inside the owned worker, not the stock collector. No stock grade is changed by this batch.
